integrity: Positive and negative finite statements are certified by two complete smooth-word generators, explicit self-shuffle witnesses, and exhaustive residual-state checks; infinite consequence uses a written parity-atom and block-orientation proof. No independent external mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The infinite color-run bound 4 is not proved optimal. The optimality of threshold 38 holds only for universal four-consecutive-even-length local windows. The theorem assumes infinitely many even-Parikh prefixes and smooth binary factors; it does not cover arbitrary binary infinite words. Historical publication priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
title: Four-run self-shuffles of infinite smooth binary words
